wrongUnits.problem: Absolute claim 'not documented anywhere'. An exception thrown by ExecuteMultipleRequest (batch-level failure) is unhandled, fails the data flow and fires the Close Gen_employercare OnError handler, which sets gen_etlprocess.statuscode=277880001 and creates an annotation with the error text. Whether CRM.Proxy/ExecuteMultipleExtension (external assembly) logs faults internally is external_unknown.
wrongUnits.correct: Per-record faults returned in the ExecuteMultiple response are discarded inside the package (warning code commented out); a batch-level exception is recorded by the OnError handler in gen_etlprocess + annotation; logging inside the external CRM.Proxy assembly is unknown.

WHERE gen_employeroperationpersonname != a.gen_operationperson OR (gen_employeroperationpersonname IS NULL AND a.gen_operationperson IS NOT NULL): when the account value is NULL, '!=' yields UNKNOWN and the second branch requires account NOT NULL, so the row is never selected; no other component clears it.
